study type: Prospective follow-up study, clinical prediction model development and internal validation
cohort: The study included 2110 randomly selected pregnant women in Bahir Dar city, Northwest Ethiopia, with a gestational age of less than 20 weeks at inclusion.
finding: The maternal near-miss incidence density rate was 1.94 per 1,000 woman-weeks, and a prediction model developed using socio-demographic and clinical factors demonstrated good discriminatory performance (C-index of 0.82) and calibration for predicting maternal near-miss.
mod_finding: A history of cesarean section was identified as an important predictor for maternal near-miss in the developed model.
